findings.title: No PersistentVolume fits the claim
findings.cause: PersistentVolumeClaim data stays Pending: it asks for 1Gi; ReadWriteMany; storageClassName "nfs", a name no StorageClass has, so only an existing PersistentVolume can satisfy it, and none fits: the nearest, kd-pv-access-mode-mismatch, offers access mode ReadWriteOnce, not the ReadWriteMany the claim asks for

evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pv-access-mode-mismatch -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'

evidence.what: claim asks for 1Gi; ReadWriteMany; storageClassName "nfs", a name no StorageClass has
PersistentVolume kd-pv-access-mode-mismatch offers access mode ReadWriteOnce, not the ReadWriteMany the claim asks for

findings.fix: Recreate the claim so that it fits an existing volume (a claim's size, access modes and class cannot be edited), or create a PersistentVolume that fits the claim: at least its size, every access mode it asks for, the same volumeMode and storageClassName, and not bound or reserved.
